name: Permits and licensing (issuing authority side)
one_line: The licensing authority's own file for a continuing permission to carry on a licensable activity, occupy the public realm, or operate a regulated premises or vehicle: application, third-party representations, suitability and fitness evidence about named individuals, grant with a numbered conditions schedule, a public register entry, an expiry and renewal cycle, and the adverse powers of review, variation, suspension and revocation exercised against a permission that already exists. It is not activated by the word permit, a licence number, an authority letterhead, or possession of a licence by its holder.

deterministic: PRECONDITION: the government schema declares no field rows under PR-6, so nothing below licenses a government fact. Every signal must evidence the holder as the DECIDING or REGISTERING authority, and must evidence a CONTINUING PERMISSION rather than a one-off administrative decision. Neither half alone fires this template.

an application record with labelled applicant, premises or vehicle or person slots, an enumerated set of licensable activities, proposed hours or scale of operation, and an operating-schedule or conditions-offered section, held with a case reference under an authority office block

a representations or objections bundle collected against one named application reference, whose members are addressed TO the licensing office from responsible authorities (police, environmental health, fire, trading standards) and from named private individuals, and whose covering structure is a receipt and consideration record rather than correspondence with one party

a determination carrying a numbered conditions schedule attached to a named permission holder, plus a reasons section and an appeal-route statement, where the office block is the issuing authority and not the recipient

a register extract or register-maintenance file: repeated rows of permission number, holder, premises or vehicle, licensable activity, status, effective date and expiry date, produced BY the authority that grants them; a single certificate held by one holder is excluded

a suitability or fitness assessment file keyed to one applicant reference, containing criminal-record disclosure, medical-fitness, right-to-work, knowledge-test or competency-check members that were RECEIVED for adjudication; the same certificates held by the person they describe are excluded
an expiry, renewal or lapse batch: a dated run of permission references with renewal status, fee position and reminder state, whose producer is the register-holding office

an inspection or compliance-visit record whose subject is a permission already in force, citing that permission's reference or its numbered conditions, and whose author signs as an authorized officer of the issuing body

an enforcement or adverse-power record aimed at an existing permission - a notice served on a licensee, a review or show-cause paper, a suspension, variation or revocation decision, or a committee hearing pack for one of those - where the proceeding is initiated BY the authority or by an objector rather than by the holder

a licensing case-management export or archive manifest whose paths repeatedly encode permission references, application stages, and register or renewal artefacts for one office; manifests are read without unpacking
needs_llm: deciding the HOLDER ROLE where a permit, licence, conditions schedule, inspection report or enforcement notice exists in two custodies with the SAME reference on both copies; the reference discriminates nothing and the interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier

separating a CONTINUING PERMISSION from a one-off administrative determination when both are called a decision - a consent that is spent when the works are built is not this row even when the authority is the same office
separating a public-realm or activity licence from an approval of building works when the same authority, the same site address and the same reference shape appear on both
recognizing an unlabeled officer report, suitability note, review recommendation or hearing minute whose function is expressed only in prose
deciding whether a representations bundle is a licensing consultation or ordinary complaint correspondence with a public office
deciding whether a permission-referenced return or sample result is licensing compliance or the post-determination monitoring stream that belongs to a neighbouring row

abstaining when custody, permission-continuity or authority status cannot be cited: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.” and “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”
never_alone: the word permit, licence, consent, authorisation, registration or approval, in a filename, a heading or a folder name; an internal permit to work, a software licence file, a parental consent form and a marriage licence all carry it
a licence, permit or case number, or any reference-shaped token; the same reference is printed on the authority's copy and on the licensee's copy of the same instrument
a licensing authority, council, agency or regulator name, letterhead, seal, .gov-style domain or PDF producer string; the body may be issuer, subject, employer or counterparty

possession of a permit or licence certificate; the holder's own copy of their premises licence, driver badge, street-trading consent or scaffold licence is the recipient side and never activates this row
a conditions schedule alone; conditions appear on planning consents, environmental permits, grant awards and commercial contracts
an inspection report alone; internal audit, safety inspection, insurance survey and certification-body reports share the structure
a site or premises address shared with an authority document; addresses recur across planning, building control, safety and licensing files for the same property
a fee, invoice or payment record naming an authority; fee payment evidences a transaction, not custody of the case
a criminal-record disclosure, medical certificate or right-to-work document alone; those are identity, medical and employment records unless a receiving licensing case is independently evidenced
a parent folder named Licensing, Permits, Regulatory or Enforcement alone
a shared download session or portal batch: “A session should never be treated as proof of topic”
a file extension or source_type: “treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning”
missing EXIF or dense OCR as proof that an image is a licensing-portal capture: “the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot”

work_types: application, supporting plan, operating schedule, and validation or fee record received from an applicant
representation, objection, or responsible-authority response received against a named application
suitability or fitness evidence received for adjudication - disclosure certificate, medical form, competency or knowledge test, right-to-work check
officer report, assessment note, or recommendation prepared for a decision-maker
hearing notice, committee pack, minute, determination, conditions schedule, reasons, and appeal-route statement
issued instrument, certificate, badge, plate or permit copy retained by the issuing office
register entry, register extract, and register-maintenance or correction record
expiry, renewal, lapse, transfer, surrender, and fee-position record
compliance inspection, test-purchase, visit report, and condition-check record against a permission in force
warning letter, review or show-cause paper, variation, suspension, revocation, refusal, and prosecution referral
appeal response, reconsideration, and court or tribunal outcome recorded back onto the case
licensing policy statement, delegation scheme, fee-setting record, and statutory publication or public notice of application
grouping_reasons: one permission over its whole life, linked by an exact permission or application reference: the group is a SERIAL, reopened by each renewal, variation, review and inspection, and it has no terminal event while the permission stands
one application stage bundle whose members are content-incoherent but share an explicit application reference - form, plan, fee record, representations, officer report, determination
one representations packet keyed to a named application, whose members come from unrelated third parties and must not acquire each other's facts
one suitability file keyed to one applicant, held as a protected sub-group; membership never converts a disclosure certificate or a medical form into a licensing fact about the case
one register or renewal run, where rows about many unrelated permission holders share only the run and must not be joined into a person-level dossier
one enforcement or review sequence against an existing permission, anchored to the permission reference plus the served notice or review reference

duplicate and version families remain universal relationships; a re-issued licence, a consolidated conditions schedule and a corrected register extract do not acquire new facts from their neighbourhood

no group is a valid outcome for a standalone permit, licence, notice or confirmation: “Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.”

template.why: Empty by contract: PR-6 leaves the government schema fieldless and a template cannot branch on undeclared fields. The recommendation stays prose. If fields are ever ratified, the organizing level for this row is the PERMISSION, not the applicant and not the calendar: the permission reference is the only anchor stable across application, grant, renewal, inspection and revocation, and a named-person or named-premises branch would publish a licensing relationship in the folder tree itself. Function (application / decision / register / enforcement) would come second and the cycle or year third. Time is not first: “For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.” Any later order remains editable: “The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions.”

collides_with.signal: The generic deciding-side row holds any authority decision with an applicant slot, a case reference, reasons and an officer block - which is exactly the shape of a licensing determination. The discriminating evidence is PERMISSION CONTINUITY, not the decision furniture: this row requires an authorisation that persists after the decision and can be renewed, varied, suspended or revoked, and a register or expiry apparatus that presupposes it; the generic row holds spent one-off determinations, certifications, registrations with no adverse-power sequence, and decisions the office does not maintain a live entry for. Shared fixture: `Licensing Sub-Committee - 14 Mill Lane - Decision Notice and Reasons.docx` sits here when its neighbourhood contains a register entry, an expiry date and a later variation or review; it sits with the generic authority-record row when the determination is the last thing the office ever writes about it. Where continuity cannot be evidenced, the generic row is the safer home and this row abstains.

Both hold an application, a case reference, an officer report, a numbered conditions schedule and a site address, issued by the same council. The discriminating evidence is WHAT IS PERMITTED: land-use development or building works, spent once built and running with the land, supports the planning row; an activity, an occupation of the public realm, a premises use, a vehicle or a person, held by a named holder and renewable, supports this row. Shared fixture: `Scaffold Licence SC-4471 - 14 Mill Lane - conditions.pdf` and a planning consent for the same address sit in different rows despite one address, one authority and one reference shape.

Reciprocating the seam that row already authored. Permit-licensing owns the lifecycle up to and including the determination for any licensable activity; the environmental row owns what the granted conditions then generate. The same fixture is named on both sides: `Permit EPR-AB1234 - Consolidated Variation V3 - Schedule 3 Emission Limits.pdf` sits here when the evidence around it is application, assessment, representations and determination, and sits with environmental regulation when the evidence around it is a stream of returns and sample certificates keyed to its condition identifiers. A permit reference alone decides nothing because it is printed on both neighbourhoods.

Both receive an application, assess suitability, impose conditions, maintain a register and exercise suspension and removal powers, and both hold disclosure and health evidence about named individuals. The discriminating evidence is WHAT THE PERMISSION ATTACHES TO: a licensable activity, premises, vehicle or trade permission issued to whoever holds it supports this row; entry to and continued standing in a titled profession, assessed against a standards edition with a fitness-to-practise proceeding, supports the regulator row. Shared fixture: a driver or trade suitability file - `Driver Licence Application 2026 - Suitability File - DVR-8817.zip` - sits here, while a byte-identical disclosure-and-health bundle assessed against professional standards for a registrant sits with the regulator. A disclosure certificate and a register both exist on either side and discriminate nothing.

Reciprocating the edge that row authored against this one. The discriminating evidence is whether the instrument approves BUILDING WORKS under a planning or building-regulations regime, which supports building-control, or licenses an ACTIVITY OR AN OCCUPATION OF THE PUBLIC REALM, which supports this row. Shared fixture, named identically on both sides: `Scaffold Licence SC-4471 - 14 Mill Lane - conditions.pdf` for the same site as a building-control consent. An authority name, a site address and a reference shape count for neither side.

Reciprocating the edge that row authored against this one. A permit to work and a public-authority permit share the word and the numbered-authorisation shape. The discriminating evidence: an issuing authority, a cited statutory power and an applicant support this row; an internal issuer and acceptor, both inside the same organisation, with a same-day validity window and a hand-back signature, support the safety row. Shared fixture: `Permit to Work - Hot Works - 14 Mill Lane - 2026-08-12.pdf`, which this row must not claim despite the word permit and the site address it shares with the scaffold licence.

Reciprocating the edge that row authored against this one, and extending it to the custody axis it already states. Two seams run together. On function: an application for a permission, a conditions schedule or a licence certificate supports this row; a periodic compelled return with no permission sought supports the filings row. On custody: the licensee's or filer's own copy - `Premises Licence - The Mill Tavern - certificate and summary.pdf`, or an annual-return acknowledgement - is the regulated entity's operating record, while the case apparatus around it (application, representations, officer report, register entry, renewal run) is this row's. Where custody does not settle, neither activates: “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”

also_holds_with.signal: A disclosure certificate, passport copy, right-to-work document or licence photograph received for adjudication is simultaneously identity evidence about the person it describes and a member of a licensing suitability file. Both readings hold; membership never converts the identity document into a licensing fact, and the licensing case never erases the identity evidence.

A medical-fitness form or practitioner report submitted with a driver, vehicle or trade licence application is genuinely medical evidence about a named person and genuinely a case member. Both readings hold; the medical member keeps its own protection inside the packet and no fitness conclusion is drawn from membership.

falls_through_to.when: representations from named private individuals, suitability and disclosure evidence, review and enforcement papers, register extracts carrying residential addresses, and any named-person licensing material with no safe accepted group
falls_through_to.design_cite: Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.

falls_through_to.when: a standalone issued licence, permit, consent, certificate or public notice of application has durable value but no authority-side case apparatus around it
falls_through_to.design_cite: Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.

falls_through_to.when: the document is administrative and permission-shaped but custody, permission-continuity, or authority status cannot be settled - the internal permit to work, the unattributed inspection report, the orphan renewal run
falls_through_to.design_cite: Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision.

falls_through_to.when: a positively evidenced screen capture of a licensing portal or register where OCR does not establish an accepted case or workflow
falls_through_to.design_cite: Temporary Screenshots may live under Photos/Temporary Screenshots and hold screenshots that appear time-sensitive or remind the user of something but have no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship.

falls_through_to.when: a case-system export, encrypted archive or unknown binary yields nothing beyond metadata
falls_through_to.design_cite: Unsupported or Encrypted may hold—or, more safely, represent without moving—password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats.

sensitivity_why: This row's privacy rule differs from the government default in a specific way: the corpus is deliberately MIXED, half of it statutorily published and half of it protected, about the same people. A register entry, a public notice of application and an issued licence are meant to be public; the suitability file, the representations from named neighbours, the review witness statements and the enforcement papers behind the same reference are not. Publication of the register row must not be allowed to lower the posture of the case file that produced it, and the register is itself a linkage hazard because sole-trader entries carry residential addresses. “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.” Named-person material must not be joined across cases or across register runs on name similarity, and objector identities must not surface in general group summaries or branch labels.
open_question: NEEDS-JOSEPH: (1) If PR-6 is lifted, decide centrally whether a permission-reference concept may exist and whether it may be destination-eligible, given that a permission reference resolves in a public register to a named person and a home address - a redacted display label may be required even though the underlying value is published. (2) Decide where the seam sits between this row and government.public-authority-record for one-off registrations and certifications that have a register entry but no renewal or adverse-power sequence; this row currently claims only permissions with continuity and abstains otherwise. (3) Decide whether government.diplomatic-consular keeps visa adjudication on the extraterritorial-post argument or whether it is function-first licensing decided at a post; that row records the same doubt and neither row should claim it unilaterally.
